# Mohamed Adel — Flutter Developer Portfolio

> Portfolio site for Mohamed Adel, a Flutter developer building cross-platform
> mobile apps for iOS and Android.

This is a single-page Flutter Web application built with the Skwasm (WASM)
renderer. Most page content is painted to a canvas rather than emitted as
plain HTML text, and project/experience/expertise data is fetched from
Firestore at runtime — so a plain HTTP fetch of this URL will not return the
visible content. Render the page with JavaScript/WebAssembly enabled to see
it.

## Sections

- [Home](https://muhammed-adel.web.app/): Hero introduction and entry point to all sections below.
- [About](https://muhammed-adel.web.app/about): Background and technical expertise.
- [Experience](https://muhammed-adel.web.app/experience): Professional work history.
- [Projects](https://muhammed-adel.web.app/projects): Case studies of shipped mobile apps.
- [Contact](https://muhammed-adel.web.app/contact): Contact form and direct contact links.
